cell_line.evidence: A549 (CCL-185), HEK293T (CRL-3216), and U2OS (HTB-96) cells were purchased from the American Type Culture Collection (Manassas, VA, USA).

cell_type.evidence: inferred: A549 (CCL-185) cells were lysed in immunoprecipitation buffer containing 25 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.5), 150 mM NaCl, 10 mM NaF, 1.5 mM MgCl2, 10 mM β-glycerophosphate, 2 mM EDTA, 5 mM Na-pyrophosphate, 1 mM Na3VO4, 1% (v/v) Triton X-100, 0.5% NP-40, 5% Glycerol, 10 μM Olaparib, and 10 μM PDD (PARG inhibitor), at 4°C for 30 min and centrifuged at 21,130 g at 4°C for 20 min.
